notes: 'Alphabetical Listing' on pdf pp1-8 (2 columns, 'Title / Source show ..... page'), OCR at 300 dpi per column. Titles are the song title only (the show/film after the slash was dropped, so some entries repeat across shows). Printed page = pdfPage + 9. OCR often garbled page numbers (B for 3, dropped hundreds digit), so each title was searched on its candidate pdf pages (top-of-page OCR for all pages, full-page OCR for the uncertain ones): 639 of 837 found on the page given (conf high); the others (conf med) use the OCR'd number minus 9 or a guess and may be wrong, especially entries whose number lost its hundreds digit (these default to a low-hundreds guess if nothing matched). Several tunes per page. No composers listed; titles may have small OCR errors.
